gloss: to strengthen; to reinforce; to intensify

definitions.gloss: to strengthen; to reinforce; to intensify
definitions.explanation: To make something stronger, more powerful, or more effective, whether physical structures, systems, abilities, or measures.

examples.japanese: セキュリティを{強化|きょうか}する。
{体力|たいりょく}を{強化|きょうか}するためにトレーニングを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started training to build up my physical strength.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{災害|さいがい}{対策|たいさく}を{強化|きょうか}し、{避難|ひなん}{体制|たいせい}の{見直|みなお}しを{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: The government is strengthening disaster preparedness measures and reviewing the evacuation system.

notes:
A widely used suru-verb appearing in business, policy, sports, technology, and daily life. It implies making something that already exists better or more robust, not creating something new. The noun {強化|きょうか} is equally common and appears in many compound nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体制|たいせい}を{強化|きょうか}する: to strengthen the system
- {規制|きせい}を{強化|きょうか}する: to tighten regulations
- {防御|ぼうぎょ}を{強化|きょうか}する: to reinforce defenses
- {連携|れんけい}を{強化|きょうか}する: to strengthen cooperation
- {筋力|きんりょく}{強化|きょうか}: muscle strengthening
- {強化|きょうか}ガラス: tempered glass
- {強化|きょうか}{合宿|がっしゅく}: training camp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {増強|ぞうきょう}する: to augment; to bolster — implies adding more resources or personnel
- {補強|ほきょう}する: to reinforce; to shore up — emphasizes fixing weak points
- {向上|こうじょう}させる: to improve; to raise — focuses on quality improvement rather than adding strength
